Known-truth one- or multi-component FPCA recovery on the exact grid

etr_evaluate_fpca_recovery.Rd

Evaluates the frozen Python 1.2 recovery estimands using a native fit and the generating truth on the same grid. Weighted assignment matches modes before signed score comparisons and principal angles.

Usage

etr_evaluate_fpca_recovery(result, truth)

Arguments

result

Explicit source-shaped FPCA result with unscaled functional components, a curve-by-mode score matrix, positive quadrature weights and an exact source truth grid.

truth

Source-shaped simulator truth containing at least as many positive generating components as the number of fitted modes; source scores, latent curves and exact time/dimension geometry must agree.

Value

Native scientific assessment with ordered source recovery metrics, including weighted mean and covariance integrated squared errors, component-matched eigenvalue errors and signed score metrics, weighted principal cosines/angles and mean latent reconstruction error. provenance$matched_truth_components contains the zero-based assignment of each fitted mode to one true mode; the companion alignment_signs gives the chosen sign orientation.

Details

Covariance differences are evaluated in column blocks to bound memory. Score comparisons use finite paired values and reconstruction error uses finite whole curves. A constant score column with enough finite pairs to calculate correlation signals an error.
